description: One recipe as a hands-free sequence for voice or chat guidance: a gather list first, then each step with its amounts, the ingredients it uses, its tip (if the chef left one) and any timer. Give the cook one step at a time, and offer to set a timer when a step has one. The recipe url shows the same steps as a checklist on the cook's phone. Works signed out (public recipes).

units.description: US cups/oz/°F or metric grams/ml/°C. Defaults to the cook's setting.

units_for.description: The cook's own unit for particular ingredients, by ingredient key or name: { "butter": "tbsp", "flour": "g" }. Units: tsp, tbsp, cup, fl oz, ml, oz, lb, g. When the cook asks for an amount in another unit, pass this rather than converting yourself; the ingredient list and every step follow. Ones that can't convert come back in ignored_units

name: get_cook_steps
title: Cook step by step
